description: This file defines the functionality to add a follower (follow a user) in the Conduit application. It contains a command class, a validator, and a handler that processes the follow request by updating the database and returning the profile information of the targeted user.

classes.name: Add.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to follow a user identified by username.

classes.name: Add.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command ensuring the username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Add.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the follow operation by updating the database and returning the profile data.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the follow command, updating the database accordingly and returning the profile.
